mechanism: Both agents have hypoglycemic effects that may be additive, increasing risk of hypoglycemia; alpha lipoic acid may enhance insulin sensitivity and glucose uptake while empagliflozin increases urinary glucose excretion.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely when combining these agents; educate patient on hypoglycemia symptoms and consider dose adjustment of empagliflozin or alpha lipoic acid if hypoglycemic episodes occur.
